description: React Native component for prompting app users to update the application when a new version is available. It checks the current app version against server data and displays a modal with update options.

methods.name: compareVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings and returns 1 if version1 > version2, -1 if version1 < version2, or 0 if equal.

methods.name: ForceUpdate
methods.description: React functional component that manages update modal visibility based on app version comparison.

methods.name: handleUpdate
methods.description: Opens the app store URL for updating the app depending on the platform.
